Hello, this is Nicole from Coast Travel. Here is your plan. It is a ten-day trip. You are going to land in Miami on March fifth, and you are going to rent a car at the airport. On day two, you are going to drive to Savannah. You are going to stay there for three nights. After that, you are going to drive to Charleston. You are not going to drive back to Miami: you are going to take a short flight from Charleston. Call me with any questions.

My wife and I are both retired now, and we have a big plan. In April, we are going to start a road trip across the country. We are going to drive about four hours a day, not more. We are not going to drive at night. My wife is going to take the photos, and I am going to drive. We are going to stay in small hotels. Are we going to be tired? Maybe. But it is going to be fantastic.

Carlos and his wife are going to take a flight to Miami. At the airport, Carlos is going to rent a car. They are going to drive along the coast to Savannah. They are going to stay in Savannah for three nights. Then they are going to drive to Charleston. At the end, Carlos is going to return the car.
